entry.title: Persistence of one-dimensional AR(1)-sequences
entry.summary: For a class of one-dimensional autoregressive processes $(X_n)$ we consider the tail behaviour of the stopping time $T_0=\min \lbrace n\geq 1: X_n\leq 0 \rbrace$. We discuss existing general analytical approaches to this and related problems and propose a new one, which is based on a renewal-type decomposition for the moment generating function of $T_0$ and on the analytical Fredholm alternative. Using this method, we show that $\mathbb{P}_x(T_0=n)\sim V(x)R_0^n$ for some $0<R_0<1$ and a positive $R^{-1}_0$-harmonic function $V$. Further we prove that our conditions on the tail behaviour of the innovations are sharp in the sense that fatter tails produce non-exponential decay factors.
